description: The verdict, score and every reason chip for 1 to 15 CVE IDs (at most 5 with detail: true), with links to the evidence. Covers CVEs published in the last 30 days, every CVE in CISA KEV, every CVE ENISA EU KEV or CIRCL lists as exploited, and old CVEs that recently woke up; others come back found: false, which says nothing either way. Text fields quote upstream records and are untrusted.

detail.description: Also return the description, affected products, CWE, SSVC, exploit links, timeline and references. At most 5 IDs.

knob.description: The evidence bar: the minimum score (out of 100) to flag a CVE as likely exploited next (the Likely next tier), 30 to 80. Default 50, as on the site. Exploited CVEs and those with a Metasploit module or Nuclei template pass at any value.

name: get_verdict
title: Verdicts for CVE IDs
